senses.en: An online audio programme available to stream or download.
To produce and distribute an online audio programme.

ex.en: I listen to a cooking podcast while making dinner.
ex.zh: 我做晚饭时会听一档烹饪播客。

ex.en: Educational podcasts allow learners to explore complex subjects while travelling or completing routine household tasks.
ex.zh: 教育类播客让学习者能够在出行或做日常家务时探索复杂的主题。

col: listen to a podcast｜收听播客
host a podcast｜主持播客节目
subscribe to a podcast｜订阅播客
tip: 收听播客用listen to a podcast，别漏掉to。

senses.en: To a great degree or in large amounts.
With great weight, force, or effort.

ex.en: It rained heavily while we waited for the bus.
ex.zh: 我们等公交车时，雨下得很大。

ex.en: Countries that rely heavily on imported fuel are particularly vulnerable to sudden changes in global energy prices.
ex.zh: 严重依赖进口燃料的国家尤其容易受到全球能源价格突变的影响。

tip: 表示下大雨用rain heavily，不用rain strongly。

senses.en: a beautiful and magical imaginary place
a real place full of wonderful things

ex.en: The children drew a map of a wonderland with talking animals.
ex.zh: 孩子们画了一张有会说话动物的仙境地图。

ex.en: In winter the frozen lake turns into a wonderland that attracts visitors from all over the province.
ex.zh: 冬天，结冰的湖变成一片仙境，吸引全省各地游客。

tip: 常与winter、snow构成景区宣传说法；虚构地名Wonderland在文学中多指仙境。

senses.en: a place open at night for music and dancing

ex.en: They went to a night-club to celebrate their graduation.
ex.zh: 他们去夜总会庆祝毕业。

ex.en: The city council has introduced stricter rules for night-club owners to reduce noise late at night.
ex.zh: 市议会为夜总会老板制定了更严格的规定，以减少深夜噪音。

col: go to a night-club｜去夜总会
tip: 英式英语中常写作 nightclub（无连字符），美式同。

senses.en: A large container for holding liquids or gases.
A heavily protected military vehicle that moves on tracks.

ex.en: The fish swam behind a rock in the tank.
ex.zh: 鱼游到了水族箱里的一块石头后面。

ex.en: Installing a rainwater tank allows households to water gardens without relying entirely on treated drinking water.
ex.zh: 安装雨水储水箱能让家庭浇灌花园时不必完全依赖经过处理的饮用水。

tip: fish tank是水族箱；汽车的油箱用fuel tank。

senses.en: to understand someone's words, actions, or intentions incorrectly

ex.en: Please don't misunderstand me; I really want to help.
ex.zh: 请别误会我，我真的想帮忙。

ex.en: Patients may misunderstand medical advice when professionals use technical language rather than clear explanations suited to their audience.
ex.zh: 如果医务人员使用专业术语，而不是适合患者理解的清晰解释，患者可能会误解医嘱。

col: misunderstand someone's intentions｜误会某人的意图
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为misunderstood。

senses.en: a thin sharp tool used for sewing
the sharp part of a syringe
to prick or tease someone

ex.en: She threaded the needle carefully before sewing the button.
ex.zh: 她仔细地把线穿过针眼，然后缝纽扣。

ex.en: The nurse used a clean needle to give the child his vaccine.
ex.zh: 护士用干净的针头给孩子打疫苗。

col: a needle in a haystack｜大海捞针
tip: 注意区分 needle（针）和 nail（钉子）。

senses.en: Related to the simplest or first stages of learning.
Relating to the first years of formal school education.

ex.en: This course teaches elementary cooking skills to complete beginners.
ex.zh: 这门课程向零基础学员教授基本烹饪技巧。

ex.en: Elementary education should develop children's curiosity as well as their ability to read and calculate.
ex.zh: 小学教育不仅应培养儿童的阅读和计算能力，还应激发他们的好奇心。

tip: elementary school主要用于美式英语，英式常用primary school。

senses.en: In, from, or relating to the west of an area.
Relating to Europe, North America, and their associated cultures.
A film or story about the historical American West.

ex.en: Our cabin faces the lake on its western shore.
ex.zh: 我们的小屋位于湖的西岸，面朝湖水。

ex.en: Investment in western regions could improve transport links and reduce economic inequalities within the country.
ex.zh: 对西部地区的投资可以改善交通联系，减少国内经济差距。

tip: 指西方国家或文化时常大写为 Western。

senses.en: An area with a particular purpose, feature, or condition.
Officially assign land to a particular use.

ex.en: Cars are not allowed inside this quiet pedestrian zone.
ex.zh: 汽车不得驶入这片安静的步行区。

ex.en: Creating a low-emission zone can reduce air pollution, provided that affordable public transport is available.
ex.zh: 只要有价格合理的公共交通，设立低排放区就能减少空气污染。

col: zone land for housing｜将土地划为住宅用地
tip: zone强调特定用途或特征的区域；area含义更宽泛。

senses.en: A strong metal used in construction and needed by the body.
A tool with a heated base for smoothing clothes.
To make clothes smooth using a heated iron.

ex.en: These old iron gates are too heavy to lift.
ex.zh: 这些旧铁门太重，抬不起来。

ex.en: A diet containing sufficient iron can help prevent anaemia, particularly among children and pregnant women.
ex.zh: 摄入足量铁的饮食有助于预防贫血，对儿童和孕妇尤其重要。

tip: 铁是不可数名词；熨斗可数，用an iron。

senses.en: an act of changing position or moving the body
an organised effort by people seeking shared social change
one main section of a long piece of music

ex.en: A sudden movement in the bushes caught my attention.
ex.zh: 灌木丛里突然有动静，引起了我的注意。

ex.en: The environmental movement has encouraged governments to adopt stronger policies on waste reduction and renewable energy.
ex.zh: 环保运动推动各国政府在减少废物和发展可再生能源方面采取更有力的政策。

tip: 指具体动作或社会运动时可数；泛指移动可不可数。

senses.en: containing different types of things or people
including both positive and negative feelings, opinions, or results

ex.en: I bought a bag of mixed nuts for our picnic.
ex.zh: 我买了一袋混合坚果，准备野餐时吃。

ex.en: The introduction of online lessons received mixed reactions from students, parents, and teachers.
ex.zh: 学生、家长和教师对引入网课的反应褒贬不一。

tip: mixed feelings指心情矛盾；mixed也是mix的过去分词。

senses.en: A liquid measure of about half a litre.

ex.en: Please add a pint of milk to the bowl.
ex.zh: 请往碗里加入一品脱牛奶。

ex.en: Consumers comparing international recipes should note that a British pint is larger than an American pint.
ex.zh: 比较不同国家食谱的消费者应注意，英制品脱比美制品脱大。

col: a pint of milk｜一品脱牛奶
tip: 英制品脱约568毫升，美制液量品脱约473毫升。

senses.en: separated by distance or time; not together
into separate pieces
except for something being considered

ex.en: We planted the young trees two metres apart.
ex.zh: 我们把这些小树间隔两米种下。

ex.en: Living apart from their families can make international students more independent, but may also cause loneliness.
ex.zh: 与家人分开生活可以让留学生更加独立，但也可能带来孤独感。

tip: apart from可指“除外”或“除……还”，需看语境。

senses.en: Someone with extensive knowledge or skill in a particular subject.
Having or showing great knowledge or skill.

ex.en: We asked an expert to examine the old painting.
ex.zh: 我们请了一位专家来鉴定这幅旧画。

ex.en: Schools should seek expert advice before introducing new technology into classrooms to support student learning.
ex.zh: 学校在将新技术引入课堂以辅助学生学习之前，应征求专家意见。

col: an expert on｜某方面的专家
tip: expert on/in表示某领域的专家。

senses.en: similar in appearance or character
in the same way, or equally for both groups

ex.en: These two jackets look alike, but one feels warmer.
ex.zh: 这两件夹克看起来很像，但有一件穿着更暖和。

ex.en: Public parks benefit children and adults alike by providing accessible spaces for exercise and relaxation.
ex.zh: 公共公园提供方便使用的运动和休闲空间，让儿童和成人同样受益。

tip: 形容词通常放在系动词后，不放在名词前。

senses.en: A special event held to mark a happy occasion.
The act of showing happiness about something special.

ex.en: We decorated the garden for our grandparents' anniversary celebration.
ex.zh: 我们为祖父母的结婚周年庆祝活动布置了花园。

ex.en: Community celebrations can strengthen social bonds by bringing together residents from different cultural backgrounds.
ex.zh: 社区庆祝活动能让不同文化背景的居民相聚，从而加强社会联系。

col: hold a celebration｜举办庆祝活动
tip: 指具体庆祝活动时可数；指庆祝行为时不可数。

senses.en: A flat shape with three straight sides and three angles.
A triangular metal musical instrument struck with a small metal stick.

ex.en: Fold the paper into a triangle before cutting it.
ex.zh: 先把纸折成三角形，再剪。

ex.en: Engineers often use triangles in bridge designs because these shapes provide strength without requiring excessive material.
ex.zh: 工程师常在桥梁设计中采用三角形，因为这种形状无需耗用过多材料就能提供强度。

tip: 英式说right-angled triangle，美式常说right triangle。

senses.en: A sour liquid used to flavour or preserve food.

ex.en: Add a little vinegar to the salad dressing.
ex.zh: 往沙拉酱里加一点醋。

ex.en: Traditional food preservation methods often use vinegar to slow bacterial growth and extend the storage life of vegetables.
ex.zh: 传统食品保存方法常用醋来减缓细菌生长，延长蔬菜的储存时间。

tip: 通常不可数，表示数量可用a bottle of vinegar。

senses.en: to think that something is wrong or bad

ex.en: My parents disapprove of playing games late at night.
ex.zh: 我父母不赞成深夜玩游戏。

ex.en: Many teachers disapprove of students using phones during class because it affects learning.
ex.zh: 许多老师不赞成学生上课用手机，因为这影响学习。

col: disapprove of the plan｜反对计划
tip: disapprove 后接介词 of：disapprove of sth。

senses.en: a visual display of information, often showing comparisons or changes
to record or show how something develops over time
a detailed map used for navigation at sea or in air

ex.en: This colourful chart shows how we spend our money.
ex.zh: 这张彩色图表展示了我们把钱花在了哪些方面。

ex.en: The chart compares the proportion of commuters using public transport in three different cities.
ex.zh: 该图表比较了三个不同城市中使用公共交通的通勤者比例。

tip: 图表用chart；普通地图用map，海图可用chart。

senses.en: not easily damaged by rust; without stains
without any moral fault or bad point

ex.en: She keeps her lunch in a stainless steel box every day.
ex.zh: 她每天把午饭放在一个不锈钢饭盒里。

ex.en: The school replaced plastic cups with stainless steel ones to cut down on waste.
ex.zh: 学校用不锈钢杯替换塑料杯，以减少浪费。

tip: 最常见搭配是stainless steel（不锈钢）。

senses.en: Unpleasantly cold, though usually not extremely cold.
Showing little warmth or friendliness towards someone.

ex.en: It felt chilly outside, so I grabbed my jacket.
ex.zh: 外面有些冷，所以我拿上了夹克。

ex.en: Providing warm public spaces during chilly weather can help protect older residents from cold-related illnesses.
ex.zh: 在寒冷天气提供温暖的公共场所，有助于保护老年居民免受寒冷引发的疾病侵害。

tip: chilly比freezing程度轻，也可形容态度冷淡。

senses.en: A natural ability to do something well.
People who have strong abilities in a particular field.

ex.en: My cousin has a real talent for drawing animals.
ex.zh: 我的表亲画动物很有天赋。

ex.en: Schools should nurture creative talent alongside academic skills to help students develop a wider range of abilities.
ex.zh: 学校应在培养学业技能的同时培育创造性才能，帮助学生发展更广泛的能力。

col: a talent for｜在某方面的天赋
tip: 表示某方面的天赋，用a talent for加名词或动名词。

senses.en: move back up after hitting a surface, or cause this
a movement back up after hitting a surface
be rejected by a bank because funds are insufficient

ex.en: The ball bounced over the fence into our neighbour's garden.
ex.zh: 球弹过篱笆，落进了邻居的花园。

ex.en: Local businesses can bounce back after economic shocks if they receive timely financial support.
ex.zh: 如果及时获得资金支持，当地企业就能在经济冲击后恢复元气。

col: bounce ideas off someone｜与某人交流想法
tip: bounce back既可指弹回，也常指受挫后恢复。

senses.en: Rest or enjoyable activity that reduces stress and tension.
The process of muscles becoming less tight.
The act of making rules or restrictions less strict.

ex.en: After work, I enjoy a warm bath for relaxation.
ex.zh: 下班后，我喜欢泡个热水澡放松一下。

ex.en: Schools should teach relaxation techniques to help students manage anxiety before important examinations.
ex.zh: 学校应教授放松技巧，帮助学生缓解重要考试前的焦虑。

tip: 表示放松、休息时通常不可数：for relaxation。

senses.en: a large sea fish, or its flesh eaten as food

ex.en: I made a tuna sandwich for lunch today.
ex.zh: 我今天做了一个金枪鱼三明治当午餐。

ex.en: International cooperation is essential to prevent overfishing and ensure that tuna populations remain healthy for future generations.
ex.zh: 国际合作对于防止过度捕捞、确保金枪鱼种群为后代保持健康至关重要。

tip: 指鱼肉时不可数；指鱼时复数通常仍为tuna。

senses.en: hard to hold or walk on; smooth and wet
difficult to trust or deal with

ex.en: The wet floor is slippery, so walk slowly.
ex.zh: 湿地很滑，所以走慢点。

ex.en: After heavy rain, the mountain path becomes slippery and hikers must move with care.
ex.zh: 大雨过后，山间小路变得湿滑，徒步者必须小心行走。

col: a slippery slope｜危险的滑坡；易出大错的开端
tip: slippery slope常作比喻，指一步步走向坏结果。

senses.en: The act of reaching the ground or shore.
A flat area at the top of or between stairs.

ex.en: The plane made a smooth landing despite the wind.
ex.zh: 尽管有风，飞机还是平稳着陆了。

ex.en: Improved weather forecasting can help pilots prepare for a safe landing during rapidly changing conditions.
ex.zh: 更准确的天气预报能帮助飞行员在天气快速变化时做好安全着陆的准备。

tip: 除“着陆”外，也指楼梯顶部或中间的平台。

senses.en: Attractive and fashionable in appearance or design

ex.en: Her stylish green jacket looked great with plain trousers.
ex.zh: 她那件时髦的绿色夹克搭配素色长裤很好看。

ex.en: Affordable, stylish furniture can encourage young consumers to choose recycled materials for their homes.
ex.zh: 价格实惠且设计时尚的家具，可以鼓励年轻消费者为家中选用再生材料。

col: a stylish design｜有格调的设计
a stylish interior｜雅致的室内空间
tip: stylish强调时尚美观；不等于昂贵或奢华。

senses.en: A prize given for achievement
To give someone a prize or money officially

ex.en: She won an award for her science project.
ex.zh: 她的科学项目获奖了。

ex.en: The university awarded scholarships to students from low-income families.
ex.zh: 这所大学向低收入家庭的学生颁发了奖学金。

tip: award 可作名词和动词；reward 多指报酬或回报，注意区分。

senses.en: the period of time when someone is alive
the length of time something lasts

ex.en: He spent a lifetime studying the stars and planets.
ex.zh: 他花了一生的时间研究星星和行星。

ex.en: Learning a new language can be a lifetime journey that brings joy and new friendships.
ex.zh: 学习一门新语言可以是一生的旅程，带来快乐和新友谊。

col: a lifetime of experience｜一生的经验
once in a lifetime｜千载难逢
tip: 常用于 a lifetime of... 或 once in a lifetime 等短语中。

senses.en: relating to a whole country or its people
a person who is a citizen of a particular country

ex.en: My sister hopes to join the national swimming team.
ex.zh: 我姐姐希望加入国家游泳队。

ex.en: National policies can help reduce regional differences in access to healthcare and education.
ex.zh: 国家政策有助于缩小医疗和教育机会方面的地区差异。

tip: national侧重一国整体；international指国际的。

senses.en: A wind instrument held sideways and played by blowing across it.

ex.en: She practises the flute by her bedroom window every afternoon.
ex.zh: 她每天下午都在卧室窗边练习长笛。

ex.en: Learning to play the flute can develop concentration and encourage children to participate in musical ensembles.
ex.zh: 学习吹长笛可以培养专注力，并鼓励儿童参加合奏团体。

tip: 英式常称演奏者为flautist，美式常用flutist。

senses.en: a printed paper ordering a bank to pay money

ex.en: Grandma paid for the new bike with a cheque.
ex.zh: 奶奶用支票支付了这辆新自行车。

ex.en: Although many people now pay by phone, some older customers still write a cheque at the bank.
ex.zh: 虽然现在很多人用手机付款，但一些年长的顾客仍在银行开支票。

tip: 英式拼写 cheque，美式拼写 check；与 check“检查”同音但意思不同。

senses.en: the inside surface at the top of a room
the highest amount or level that is allowed

ex.en: A small spider was crawling across the ceiling.
ex.zh: 一只小蜘蛛正爬过天花板。

ex.en: A ceiling on annual rent increases could protect tenants, although it might discourage investment in housing.
ex.zh: 限制年度租金涨幅可以保护租户，但也可能抑制住房投资。

col: set a ceiling on｜为……设定上限
tip: ceiling是室内天花板；roof是建筑外部的屋顶。

senses.en: quiet and calm, without disturbance or worry
not involving war, violence, or fighting

ex.en: The lake looks peaceful in the early morning light.
ex.zh: 晨光中的湖泊显得格外宁静。

ex.en: Creating peaceful public spaces can improve residents' wellbeing and encourage more people to spend time outdoors.
ex.zh: 营造宁静的公共空间可以提升居民的幸福感，并鼓励更多人到户外活动。

tip: 可形容环境安静，也可指行动不使用暴力。

senses.en: The ability to form mental pictures or invent new ideas.

ex.en: With a little imagination, this box becomes a spaceship.
ex.zh: 只需一点想象力，这个盒子就能变成宇宙飞船。

ex.en: Creative activities encourage children to use their imagination and approach unfamiliar problems from different perspectives.
ex.zh: 创意活动鼓励儿童运用想象力，从不同角度处理陌生的问题。

col: a figment of the imagination｜凭空想象的事物
tip: imaginative指有想象力的；imaginary指想象中的。

senses.en: not kind or welcoming towards others
making an activity difficult or causing harm

ex.en: The new neighbour seemed unfriendly but was simply shy.
ex.zh: 新邻居看似冷淡，其实只是害羞。

ex.en: An unfriendly working environment can discourage employees from sharing ideas and seeking support.
ex.zh: 不友好的工作环境可能使员工不愿分享想法或寻求支持。

tip: 虽以-ly结尾，但通常是形容词，不是副词。

senses.en: The loud sound in the sky caused by lightning
Produce thunder or make a similarly loud, deep noise

ex.en: A sudden clap of thunder made the windows shake.
ex.zh: 一声突如其来的雷鸣震得窗户直晃。

ex.en: Outdoor sports events should be suspended when thunder indicates that a storm is dangerously close.
ex.zh: 当雷声表明雷暴已逼近到危险距离时，应暂停户外体育赛事。

col: a clap of thunder｜一声雷响
a rumble of thunder｜低沉的隆隆雷声
tip: thunder指雷声，通常不可数；lightning指闪电。

senses.en: A difficult task or situation that tests someone's abilities.
Question whether something is true, fair, or acceptable.
Invite someone to compete or test their abilities.

ex.en: Cooking dinner for twelve guests was quite a challenge.
ex.zh: 给十二位客人做晚饭真是个不小的挑战。

ex.en: Providing affordable housing remains a major challenge for cities experiencing rapid population growth and rising land prices.
ex.zh: 对于人口快速增长、地价不断上涨的城市而言，提供可负担住房仍是一项重大挑战。

col: meet a challenge｜成功应对挑战
challenge someone to a contest｜向某人发起比赛挑战
tip: challenge作动词可直接接观点，表示质疑。

senses.en: A small cup with a handle, used for drinking tea.

ex.en: She placed a delicate teacup beside the biscuit plate.
ex.zh: 她把一只精致的茶杯放在饼干盘旁。

ex.en: A museum display of decorated teacups can reveal how domestic tastes and manufacturing techniques changed over time.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出的装饰茶杯可以揭示家居审美和制造技术如何随时间变化。

col: a teacup and saucer｜茶杯和茶托
a storm in a teacup｜小题大做
tip: teacup是茶杯；a cup of tea是一杯茶。

senses.en: to transfer files from a device to an online system
the transfer of a file online, or the file itself

ex.en: I uploaded our picnic photos to a shared folder.
ex.zh: 我把我们野餐的照片上传到了共享文件夹。

ex.en: Students can upload their assignments to a secure platform, allowing teachers to provide timely feedback.
ex.zh: 学生可以将作业上传至安全平台，方便教师及时提供反馈。

col: upload to a server｜上传至服务器
tip: 上传用upload，下载用download；上传至某处用to。

senses.en: A small piece of soft paper used for wiping.
A group of similar cells performing a particular bodily function.

ex.en: She handed me a tissue when I sneezed.
ex.zh: 我打喷嚏时，她递给我一张纸巾。

ex.en: Scientists are developing new treatments that help damaged tissue recover more effectively after an injury.
ex.zh: 科学家正在开发新疗法，帮助受损组织在受伤后更有效地修复。

col: a box of tissues｜一盒纸巾
tip: 纸巾是可数名词；生物组织通常不可数。

senses.en: something said or written to express information or an opinion
a formal public announcement about a particular matter
a record showing financial transactions over a period

ex.en: Her statement about the broken window surprised everyone.
ex.zh: 她关于那扇破窗的说法让所有人都很惊讶。

ex.en: The council issued a statement explaining how the proposed transport scheme would benefit residents with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 市议会发表声明，解释拟议的交通方案将如何惠及行动不便的居民。

tip: 作“陈述”时是可数名词；银行对账单也用statement。

senses.en: without problems or difficulty
in a way that is even and not rough

ex.en: The new bike runs smoothly after my father repaired it.
ex.zh: 父亲修好后，这辆新自行车骑起来很顺畅。

ex.en: If everyone follows the plan, the school project should go smoothly this term.
ex.zh: 如果每个人都按计划行事，这个学期的学校项目应该会顺利进行。

tip: go/run smoothly 是常用搭配，表示“进展/运转顺利”。

senses.en: A woman who is getting married or has just married.

ex.en: The bride held fresh flowers as she entered the garden.
ex.zh: 新娘手捧鲜花走进花园。

ex.en: In many cultures, the bride and her family share responsibility for organising the wedding celebration.
ex.zh: 在许多文化中，新娘及其家人共同负责筹办婚礼庆典。

tip: bride指新娘，groom指新郎。

senses.en: a small salty fish often sold in tins

ex.en: He opened a tin of sardines for a quick lunch.
ex.zh: 他打开一罐沙丁鱼当快手午餐。

ex.en: Sardines are cheap and full of protein, so many students keep a few tins in their rooms.
ex.zh: 沙丁鱼便宜又富含蛋白质，所以很多学生会在宿舍放几罐。

col: a tin of sardines｜一罐沙丁鱼
packed like sardines｜挤得像沙丁鱼一样
tip: 常见短语 packed like sardines 形容极其拥挤。

senses.en: unable to understand something or think clearly
unclear or difficult to follow because of poor organisation

ex.en: I felt confused when both doors led outside.
ex.zh: 两扇门都通向外面，让我感到困惑。

ex.en: Students may become confused if teachers introduce too many unfamiliar concepts in a single lesson.
ex.zh: 如果教师在一堂课中引入太多陌生概念，学生可能会感到困惑。

tip: confused形容人困惑；confusing形容事物令人困惑。

senses.en: Not often; on very few occasions.

ex.en: We rarely eat outside when the weather turns cold.
ex.zh: 天气转冷时，我们很少在户外吃饭。

ex.en: People living in remote villages rarely have easy access to specialist medical services.
ex.zh: 住在偏远村庄的人很少能方便地获得专科医疗服务。

tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；本身有否定意味。

senses.en: An arrangement to keep a room, seat, or table available.
A doubt that prevents complete acceptance of something.

ex.en: I made a reservation for dinner by the window.
ex.zh: 我预订了一个靠窗的位置吃晚饭。

ex.en: Some residents expressed reservations about the proposed airport expansion because of increased noise pollution.
ex.zh: 一些居民担心噪声污染加剧，对拟议中的机场扩建持保留意见。

tip: 表示疑虑常用复数：have reservations about。

senses.en: The smallest amount or level possible or allowed.
Being the smallest amount or level possible or allowed.

ex.en: Please keep the noise to a minimum tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚请尽量保持安静。

ex.en: A higher minimum wage may improve living standards for workers in low-paid service jobs.
ex.zh: 提高最低工资可能改善低薪服务业劳动者的生活水平。

col: keep something to a minimum｜将某事物减至最低程度
tip: a minimum of 后接数量，表示“至少”。

senses.en: a public statement giving people information or news

ex.en: We heard an announcement about our train being delayed.
ex.zh: 我们听到了一则关于所乘列车晚点的通知。

ex.en: The government's announcement of additional education funding was welcomed by teachers and parents.
ex.zh: 政府宣布追加教育经费，受到教师和家长的欢迎。

tip: 表示发布公告时用make an announcement。

senses.en: A body part or aircraft structure that enables flight.
A section extending from the main part of a building.
A group within an organisation sharing particular views or aims.

ex.en: The bird stretched its wings before leaving the branch.
ex.zh: 那只鸟飞离树枝前展开了翅膀。

ex.en: The hospital's new wing will provide additional beds and specialist facilities for the region's growing population.
ex.zh: 医院新建的侧楼将提供更多床位和专科设施，以服务该地区不断增长的人口。

col: spread your wings｜展开翅膀；拓展自我
tip: 鸟的翅膀和飞机机翼都用wing，通常成对用复数。

senses.en: to create a problem or danger
to sit or stand in a particular position for a photo or painting
a particular position in which someone stands or sits

ex.en: The heavy rain may pose a danger to drivers on this road.
ex.zh: 大雨可能对这条路上的司机构成危险。

ex.en: Climate change poses a serious threat to coastal cities and the people who live there.
ex.zh: 气候变化对沿海城市及其居民构成严重威胁。

col: pose for a photo｜摆姿势拍照
tip: 常与 threat, problem, danger 搭配；注意与 pause（暂停）区分。

senses.en: A hard pointed growth on the head of some animals.
A device on a vehicle that makes a loud warning sound.
A musical instrument played by blowing into a tube.

ex.en: The goat caught its horn in the fence.
ex.zh: 那只山羊的角卡在了栅栏里。

ex.en: Frequent use of car horns contributes to noise pollution and reduces residents' quality of life.
ex.zh: 频繁使用汽车喇叭会造成噪声污染，降低居民的生活质量。

tip: 动物的角和车辆喇叭都用horn，均为可数名词。

senses.en: an artificial waterway for boats or carrying water
a narrow passage inside the body

ex.en: We watched a narrow boat glide along the canal.
ex.zh: 我们看着一艘窄船沿运河缓缓驶过。

ex.en: Restoring historic canals can attract tourists while providing valuable habitats for wildlife in densely populated urban areas.
ex.zh: 修复历史悠久的运河既能吸引游客，也能为人口密集城区的野生动物提供宝贵的栖息地。

tip: canal通常为人工水道；river指天然河流。

senses.en: Animals and other living things in their natural surroundings.

ex.en: We watched the wildlife quietly from behind the trees.
ex.zh: 我们躲在树后，静静地观察野生动物。

ex.en: Protecting wildlife requires governments to preserve natural habitats and limit development in environmentally sensitive areas.
ex.zh: 保护野生生物需要政府维护自然栖息地，并限制生态敏感地区的开发。

col: a wildlife reserve｜野生生物保护区
tip: 不可数名词；wildlife park中作名词定语。

senses.en: The upper front part of the body, enclosing heart and lungs.
A large strong box with a lid, used for storage.

ex.en: She held the sleeping kitten gently against her chest.
ex.zh: 她把熟睡的小猫轻轻抱在胸前。

ex.en: Workers exposed to polluted air may develop chest problems, highlighting the importance of effective workplace ventilation.
ex.zh: 接触污染空气的工人可能出现胸部疾病，这凸显了工作场所有效通风的重要性。

tip: chest指胸部或大箱子；chest of drawers才是抽屉柜。

senses.en: going to happen soon

ex.en: Everyone is excited about the upcoming school sports meeting.
ex.zh: 大家都对即将到来的校运动会感到兴奋。

ex.en: In the upcoming report, the government will explain its new plan for clean energy.
ex.zh: 在即将发布的报告中，政府将解释其清洁能源新计划。

col: the upcoming exam｜即将到来的考试
tip: 只用在名词前，如upcoming exam；不说The exam is upcoming。

senses.en: Through natural processes rather than human action
As would normally be expected
Because of qualities someone or something has from birth

ex.en: Let your hair dry naturally after you wash it.
ex.zh: 洗完头后，让头发自然晾干。

ex.en: Some pollutants occur naturally in the environment, but human activities can increase their concentration to harmful levels.
ex.zh: 某些污染物天然存在于环境中，但人类活动会使其浓度上升到有害水平。

col: come naturally to someone｜对某人来说轻而易举
tip: 句首Naturally常表示“当然”，不一定指天然。

senses.en: almost not, or only to a very small degree
only just, before something else happens

ex.en: I could hardly hear you over the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 雨声太大，我几乎听不见你说话。

ex.en: Expanding roads alone is hardly sufficient to solve traffic congestion without improvements to public transport.
ex.zh: 如果不改善公共交通，仅靠拓宽道路几乎不足以解决交通拥堵。

tip: hardly意为几乎不，并非hard的副词形式。

senses.en: the state of being protected from danger or harm

ex.en: Please wear a helmet for your own safety.
ex.zh: 为了你自身的安全，请戴上头盔。

ex.en: Improving road safety requires better street design as well as stricter enforcement of traffic laws.
ex.zh: 改善道路安全既需要更好的街道设计，也需要更严格地执行交通法规。

col: for safety reasons｜出于安全考虑
tip: 通常不可数；safe是形容词，safety是名词。

senses.en: A small house, usually in the countryside.

ex.en: Their cottage has a tiny garden full of roses.
ex.zh: 他们的乡间小屋有一个种满玫瑰的小花园。

ex.en: Converting an unused cottage into holiday accommodation can provide rural families with an additional source of income.
ex.zh: 将闲置的村舍改为度假住宿，可以为农村家庭增加一项收入来源。

tip: 通常指乡间小住宅，不等同于豪华的villa。

senses.en: having a liking or affection for someone or something
showing or expressing warmth and affection

ex.en: My grandmother is fond of walking by the river.
ex.zh: 我奶奶喜欢在河边散步。

ex.en: Many adults retain fond memories of teachers who encouraged their curiosity and supported their ambitions.
ex.zh: 许多成年人仍深情地记得那些激发他们好奇心、支持他们志向的老师。

tip: be fond of后接名词或动词-ing，不接to do。

senses.en: A public display of art, objects, or products.

ex.en: We visited a photography exhibition at the local museum.
ex.zh: 我们参观了当地博物馆的一场摄影展。

ex.en: An interactive exhibition can make scientific discoveries more accessible to children and encourage their interest in research.
ex.zh: 互动展览能让儿童更容易理解科学发现，并激发他们对研究的兴趣。

tip: exhibition指整场展览；exhibit可指一件展品。

senses.en: The state of being hard to do or understand.
A problem that makes progress or success harder.

ex.en: I had difficulty opening the jar with wet hands.
ex.zh: 我手湿着，很难打开那个罐子。

ex.en: Students with limited internet access may have difficulty completing assignments that require extensive online research.
ex.zh: 网络使用受限的学生可能难以完成需要大量网上研究的作业。

col: have difficulty doing something｜做某事有困难
tip: 用have difficulty doing，不用difficulty to do。

senses.en: The gas water becomes when heated, often seen as white mist.
To cook food using steam from boiling water.

ex.en: Steam rose from the soup as I lifted the lid.
ex.zh: 我揭开盖子时，汤里升起了热气。

ex.en: Some power stations use heat to produce steam, which drives turbines and generates electricity.
ex.zh: 一些发电站利用热量产生蒸汽，推动涡轮机发电。

col: run out of steam｜耗尽精力
tip: steam作名词通常不可数；作动词可表示蒸食物。

senses.en: attractive in a sexual way
exciting and attractive (informal)

ex.en: The magazine is full of ads for sexy clothes and perfume.
ex.zh: 这本杂志满是性感服装和香水的广告。

ex.en: Some students think coding is sexy, but it takes long hours of quiet practice to become good.
ex.zh: 有些学生觉得编程很酷，但要变得出色需要长时间安静地练习。

col: a sexy idea｜吸引人的想法
tip: 口语中也可指“时髦的、吸引人的”，但正式作文慎用。

senses.en: a strong feeling of fear, shock, or disgust
a type of fiction intended to frighten its audience

ex.en: She watched in horror as her laptop fell downstairs.
ex.zh: 她惊恐地看着自己的笔记本电脑掉下楼梯。

ex.en: Horror films often use music and lighting to create tension rather than relying entirely on frightening images.
ex.zh: 恐怖电影常用音乐和灯光制造紧张气氛，而非完全依赖吓人的画面。

tip: 情绪义通常不可数；in horror表示惊恐地。

senses.en: a written account of someone's life by another person

ex.en: I'm reading a biography of an explorer before bed.
ex.zh: 我睡前正在读一本探险家的传记。

ex.en: A well-researched biography can reveal how social conditions influence an individual's choices and achievements.
ex.zh: 一本研究扎实的传记可以揭示社会条件如何影响个人的选择与成就。

col: a biography of someone｜某人的传记
an authorised biography｜经本人授权的传记
tip: biography是他人为某人写的传记；自传用autobiography。

senses.en: to risk money on the result of an uncertain event
to say confidently that something is true or will happen
an agreement to risk money on an uncertain result

ex.en: I bet you left your keys in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我敢说你把钥匙落在厨房了。

ex.en: Some investors bet on emerging technologies despite considerable uncertainty about their future commercial success.
ex.zh: 一些投资者押注新兴技术，尽管这些技术未来能否取得商业成功仍很不确定。

tip: 过去式和过去分词通常仍是bet；I bet常表确信。

senses.en: not real; made to look real
a copy made to deceive people
to make something false; to pretend

ex.en: He bought a fake watch at a low price.
ex.zh: 他以低价买了一块假表。

ex.en: The police warned people to be careful of fake news on social media.
ex.zh: 警方警告人们要小心社交媒体上的假新闻。

tip: fake可作形容词、名词和动词，注意fake news是常见搭配。

senses.en: A place where something is built, happens, or once existed.
A collection of connected web pages.
Place or build something in a particular location.

ex.en: Workers put a fence around the building site.
ex.zh: 工人们在建筑工地周围围起了围栏。

ex.en: The proposed hospital site is close to public transport, making healthcare more accessible to residents.
ex.zh: 拟建医院的选址靠近公共交通，方便居民获得医疗服务。

tip: site指地点或网站；sight指视力或景象，二者同音。

senses.en: To say or write something in reply.
To react to something through actions or physical changes.

ex.en: I asked about dinner, but nobody responded to my message.
ex.zh: 我发消息问晚饭怎么安排，却没人回复。

ex.en: Healthcare systems must respond quickly to changing population needs while maintaining high standards of care.
ex.zh: 医疗体系必须迅速回应不断变化的人口需求，同时维持高水平的医疗服务。

col: respond to a question｜回答问题
respond to treatment｜对治疗产生反应
tip: respond to后接回应对象，不能直接接宾语。

senses.en: an arrangement accepted by two or more people or groups
the state of sharing an opinion or accepting a proposal
a grammatical match between related words in a sentence

ex.en: We reached an agreement about sharing the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我们就共用厨房达成了协议。

ex.en: International agreements on carbon emissions are more effective when participating countries establish clear targets and monitor progress.
ex.zh: 当参与国设定明确目标并监督进展时，关于碳排放的国际协定会更加有效。

tip: 具体协议可数；表示意见一致时通常不可数。

senses.en: A system of connected people, things or places.
A group of broadcasting stations sharing programmes.
To meet people and develop useful professional relationships.

ex.en: Our home network connects three laptops and a printer.
ex.zh: 我们的家庭网络连接着三台笔记本电脑和一台打印机。

ex.en: An efficient public transport network can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment.
ex.zh: 高效的公共交通网络可以缓解交通拥堵，并让人们更方便地前往工作地点。

col: network with colleagues｜与同行建立联系
tip: network强调多个节点之间相互连接。

senses.en: to have something inside or as a part
to prevent something from spreading or becoming stronger

ex.en: This small box contains all my sewing supplies.
ex.zh: 这个小盒子里装着我所有的缝纫用品。

ex.en: Processed foods often contain large amounts of salt, which can contribute to serious health problems.
ex.zh: 加工食品往往含有大量盐分，可能导致严重的健康问题。

tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语；表示“含有”时通常不用进行时。

senses.en: a covered passage with shops, often with arches
a place with coin-operated game machines

ex.en: We walked through a beautiful arcade with small shops on both sides.
ex.zh: 我们走过一条漂亮的拱廊，两边都是小商店。

ex.en: The old arcade in the city centre has been turned into a cultural centre for young people.
ex.zh: 市中心的老拱廊街已被改造成年轻人的文化中心。

tip: arcade可指有拱顶的商业街，也可指游戏厅；注意与arc（弧）区分。

senses.en: Natural light from the sun, or the time it is available.

ex.en: Let's finish planting these flowers while there's still daylight.
ex.zh: 趁天还亮着，我们把这些花种完吧。

ex.en: Designing classrooms to receive more daylight can reduce electricity use and create a more comfortable learning environment.
ex.zh: 在设计教室时增加自然采光，可以减少用电并营造更舒适的学习环境。

col: in broad daylight｜在光天化日之下
tip: 通常不可数；in broad daylight意为在光天化日之下。

senses.en: paper used for writing letters or short messages

ex.en: She took some notepaper from the desk drawer.
ex.zh: 她从书桌抽屉里拿出了一些便条纸。

ex.en: Providing recycled notepaper in offices is a simple measure that can support more sustainable purchasing practices.
ex.zh: 在办公室提供再生便条纸，是支持更可持续采购方式的一项简单措施。

col: a sheet of notepaper｜一张信纸
a pad of notepaper｜一本便条纸
tip: 不可数名词；一张用a sheet of notepaper。

senses.en: Towards the back, or with the back facing forwards.
In the opposite order or direction to the usual one.

ex.en: She stepped backwards to let the cyclist pass.
ex.zh: 她向后退了一步，让骑车的人过去。

ex.en: Researchers can work backwards from current pollution levels to identify the likely sources of environmental damage.
ex.zh: 研究人员可以根据当前污染水平反向追溯，找出环境破坏的可能来源。

tip: backwards是副词；修饰名词通常用backward。

senses.en: Having little colour, or less colour than usual.
Giving only a weak light.
To lose colour or seem less impressive in comparison.

ex.en: You look pale; sit down and have some water.
ex.zh: 你脸色苍白，坐下来喝点水吧。

ex.en: The financial benefits of tourism may pale in comparison with its long-term environmental costs.
ex.zh: 与旅游业带来的长期环境代价相比，其经济收益可能显得微不足道。

col: pale in comparison｜相比之下相形见绌
tip: pale可指脸色苍白或颜色浅，不等于白色。

senses.en: Difficult to do, deal with, or endure
Able to cope with hardship, pain, or difficult conditions
Strong and difficult to break, cut, or damage

ex.en: It was a tough climb, but the view was worth it.
ex.zh: 这段攀登很艰难，但沿途的风景让付出变得值得。

ex.en: Governments face tough choices when balancing economic growth with the need to protect natural resources.
ex.zh: 在平衡经济增长与保护自然资源的需求时，政府面临艰难的抉择。

tip: 读音与rough押韵；形容肉时指难嚼、老。

senses.en: Sold without certain taxes, especially to international travellers.
Without paying certain taxes on goods.

ex.en: She bought some duty-free perfume before boarding her flight.
ex.zh: 登机前，她买了一些免税香水。

ex.en: Duty-free shopping can generate substantial revenue for airports, although travellers may not always find the lowest prices.
ex.zh: 免税购物能为机场带来可观收入，但旅客未必总能买到价格最低的商品。

tip: duty此处指关税；免税商品仍受入境额度限制。

senses.en: person who holds the best result in a sport or activity

ex.en: The recordholder ran the race in under ten seconds.
ex.zh: 纪录保持者用不到十秒跑完了比赛。

ex.en: She became the world recordholder after months of hard training and careful diet.
ex.zh: 经过数月刻苦训练和严格饮食，她成为了世界纪录保持者。

col: the current recordholder｜现任纪录保持者
tip: 也写作 record holder，指保持某项最佳成绩的人。

senses.en: belief in gods or spiritual powers, with related practices

ex.en: We learned about different religions at school today.
ex.zh: 今天我们在学校了解了不同的宗教。

ex.en: Schools can teach students about religion while encouraging respect for people with different beliefs.
ex.zh: 学校可以教授宗教知识，同时鼓励学生尊重持不同信仰的人。

tip: 泛指宗教时不可数；指某一种宗教时可数。

senses.en: feeling very nervous and unable to think calmly

ex.en: She felt panicky when she could not find her exam card.
ex.zh: 找不到准考证时她很慌张。

ex.en: Take a deep breath when you feel panicky during a difficult test.
ex.zh: 难题考试中感到慌张时，深呼吸一下。

tip: panicky 是形容词，口语常用；panic 名词/动词，过去式 panicked。

senses.en: a short sleep, usually during the day
to sleep briefly, usually during the day

ex.en: I took a short nap after lunch on Sunday.
ex.zh: 星期天午饭后，我小睡了一会儿。

ex.en: A brief afternoon nap may improve alertness, but it should not replace adequate sleep at night.
ex.zh: 下午短暂小睡可能提高警觉性，但不应代替充足的夜间睡眠。

col: a power nap｜恢复精力的短睡
tip: 动词变化要双写p：napped、napping。

senses.en: by a small amount or to a small degree

ex.en: Please open the window slightly; it feels warm.
ex.zh: 请把窗户稍微打开一点，感觉有些热。

ex.en: Although average incomes rose slightly, many households continued to struggle with higher food and energy costs.
ex.zh: 尽管平均收入略有上升，许多家庭仍难以应付不断上涨的食品和能源费用。

tip: 可修饰形容词、比较级或动词，如slightly higher。

senses.en: an official document allowing someone to do something
freedom to depart from usual rules or factual accuracy

ex.en: I keep my driving licence in my wallet.
ex.zh: 我把驾驶执照放在钱包里。

ex.en: Requiring a licence to operate tourist boats can help authorities maintain safety standards on busy waterways.
ex.zh: 要求旅游船持证运营，可以帮助主管部门维持繁忙水道的安全标准。

col: apply for a licence｜申请许可证
tip: 英式名词用licence，动词用license；美式都用license。

senses.en: A large hunting bird with powerful claws and sharp eyesight

ex.en: An eagle circled slowly above the rocky valley.
ex.zh: 一只鹰在岩石遍布的山谷上方缓缓盘旋。

ex.en: Protecting mountain forests helps preserve the hunting grounds and nesting sites of the eagle.
ex.zh: 保护山地森林有助于保全鹰的猎食区和筑巢地。

tip: eagle通常指大型猛禽；eagle-eyed形容眼力敏锐。

senses.en: an official document showing successful completion of a course

ex.en: She proudly showed her diploma to her grandparents.
ex.zh: 她自豪地向祖父母展示了自己的毕业文凭。

ex.en: A vocational diploma can provide practical skills that help graduates find employment in specialised industries.
ex.zh: 职业教育文凭课程可以提供实用技能，帮助毕业生在专业行业中找到工作。

col: diploma in nursing｜护理专业文凭
tip: diploma多指毕业或课程文凭，不等同于degree学位。

senses.en: finding something previously unknown, or the thing that is found

ex.en: We made an exciting discovery behind the old cupboard.
ex.zh: 我们在旧橱柜后有了一个令人兴奋的发现。

ex.en: The discovery of new antibiotics could help health services respond more effectively to drug-resistant infections.
ex.zh: 新抗生素的发现有助于医疗机构更有效地应对耐药性感染。

tip: discovery是发现原已存在的事物，不同于invention。

senses.en: A series of actions or changes leading to a result.
Treat materials or information through a series of organised steps.

ex.en: Making bread is a slow process, but I enjoy it.
ex.zh: 做面包是个缓慢的过程，但我很享受。

ex.en: The application process should be transparent so that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate.
ex.zh: 申请程序应当透明，以确保所有申请者都有平等的参与机会。

col: in the process of｜在……过程中
tip: in the process of后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: covered with rocks
difficult and likely to fail

ex.en: They walked carefully along the rocky path by the sea.
ex.zh: 他们小心地走在海边的岩石小路上。

ex.en: The project had a rocky start, but the team worked hard and finally succeeded.
ex.zh: 项目起步艰难，但团队努力最终成功了。

tip: 除指多岩石外，常比喻困难或不稳定。

senses.en: the time when someone stops working, often because of age

ex.en: After retirement, he spends his mornings walking in the park.
ex.zh: 退休后，他每天上午在公园里散步。

ex.en: As more people reach retirement age, the government must plan better health care for older citizens.
ex.zh: 随着更多人达到退休年龄，政府必须为老年公民规划更好的医疗保健。

tip: retire 是动词，retired 是形容词“退休的”；注意与 retreat“撤退”区分。

senses.en: Performances or activities that people enjoy watching or doing.

ex.en: The hotel provides live entertainment beside the pool every evening.
ex.zh: 酒店每晚都在泳池边提供现场娱乐表演。

ex.en: Affordable entertainment facilities can improve urban life by giving residents opportunities to relax and socialise.
ex.zh: 价格亲民的娱乐设施能让居民有机会放松和社交，从而改善城市生活。

col: a form of entertainment｜一种娱乐形式
tip: 通常不可数：提供娱乐用provide entertainment。

senses.en: to think about something you do not know
a feeling of surprise and admiration
something unusually impressive or surprising

ex.en: I wonder why the cat keeps watching that cupboard.
ex.zh: 我想知道那只猫为什么一直盯着那个橱柜。

ex.en: Many parents wonder whether online lessons can provide the same social benefits as classroom learning.
ex.zh: 许多家长想知道，线上课程能否提供与课堂学习相同的社交益处。

tip: wonder后接疑问词从句时，用陈述语序。
